# Generated by herramientas/space_auto.py. Automatic mode of the space agency, for the player.

# First time the page opens: the usual choices, and the budget kept where it is.
mdr_space_auto_defaults = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = mdr_space_auto_ready } }
		set_country_flag = mdr_space_auto_ready
		set_country_flag = mdr_space_auto_projects
		set_country_flag = mdr_space_auto_goals
		set_country_flag = mdr_space_auto_hq
		set_country_flag = mdr_space_auto_budget
		set_country_flag = mdr_space_auto_cutback
		set_country_flag = mdr_space_auto_companies
		set_country_flag = mdr_space_auto_colonies
		set_variable = { mdr_space_auto_min_chance = 90 }
		set_variable = { mdr_space_auto_reserve = 12 }
		set_variable = { mdr_space_auto_target = mdr_space_budget }
		set_variable = { mdr_space_auto_priority = 0 }
	}
	mdr_space_auto_figures = yes
}

mdr_space_auto_figures = {
	set_variable = { mdr_space_auto_target_pct = mdr_space_auto_target }
	divide_variable = { mdr_space_auto_target_pct = 100 }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_space_auto_dirty = 1 }
}
